title: Activists shift anti-CEC demonstration to Pune after release
seoTitle: Pune protest against CEC and electoral rules

tea.why: Activists are protesting to demand electoral reforms and the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner.
tea.want: Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, cancellation of the SIR exercise, and broader electoral reforms.
tea.changed: Oct 10: Pune Police detained 102 protesters near Lal Mahal and released them after a three-hour process.

summary: Following their release from detention in Madhya Pradesh after a High Court order, fourteen students and activists announced they would hold their anti-CEC demonstration in Pune instead of Delhi. The group had been traveling to the national capital to join a larger CJP protest when they were taken into custody. Protesters are demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, the cancellation of the SIR exercise, and broader electoral reforms. Concurrently, Pune Police detained 102 individuals near Lal Mahal in connection with a CJP-supporting gathering, holding them at Lashkar Police Station before releasing them. Following their release, some demonstrators staged a brief fifteen-minute rasta roko outside the police station.
demands: Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
response: According to Pune Police, 102 protesters were detained near Lal Mahal for verification and released after recording their details at Lashkar Police Station. Police stated that legal action would be taken against gatherings organized without prior permission.

updates.text: Released by a court order, activists announced they would shift their demonstration from Delhi to Pune.
Pune Police detained 102 CJP supporters near Lal Mahal and later released them following verification.
